_note: AI-Friendly Declaration - registry of declaring sites (added 2026-09-13). Specification: /declaration/ (English) and /jp/declaration/ (Japanese); schema: /api/ai-friendly.schema.json; each site's own file is at <site>/.well-known/ai-friendly.json. "declared" is the site's self-declaration copied verbatim; "verified" is AI Lifeline's monthly machine check of items 1 (crawl_allowed: no full Disallow: / for the 8 observed AI user-agents in robots.txt) and 2 (machine_readable: the declared URL answers 200 without credentials with a non-HTML body). verified: true / false / null (null = not verified, e.g. fetch failed; it is not a negative). Items 3-5 are never machine-checked (always null). The two blocks are never merged. Only sites with list_me=true are named; list_me=false sites are a count. Listing is not an endorsement; no scores or ranks exist under this specification.
check_cycle: monthly (with the data chapter robots.txt observation)

crawl_allowed.detail: no full disallow for the 8 observed AI user-agents

provenance.detail: item provenance is self-declared; AI Lifeline does not verify it

ai_contact.detail: item ai_contact is self-declared; AI Lifeline does not verify it

no_extraction.detail: item no_extraction is self-declared; AI Lifeline does not verify it
